1.text: Iyi ndirimbo ni Zaburi ya Asafu.

3.text: Kuko abanzi bawe bagira imidugararo,Abakwanga babyukije umutwe.

4.text: Bagambirira imigambi y'uburiganya ngo bagirire nabi ubwoko bwawe,Bagire inama abo urindira mu rwihisho.

5.text: Baravuze bati“Nimuze tubarimbure bataba ishyanga,Kugira ngo izina ry'Abisirayeli ritibukwa ukundi.”

6.text: Kuko bahuje umutima wo kujya inama,Ni wowe basezeraniye.

7.text: Ni bo banyamahema ba Edomu n'Abishimayeli,Kandi n'Abamowabu n'Abahagari,

8.text: N'Abagebalu n'Abamoni n'Abamaleki,N'Abafilisitiya n'abatuye i Tiro.

9.text: Abashuri na bo bafatanije na bo,Batabaye bene Loti.Sela.

10.text: Ubagirire nk'ibyo wagiriye Abamidiyani,Nk'ibyo wagiriye Sisera na Yabini ku mugezi Kishoni.

12.text: Uhindure abatware babo nka Orebu na Zēbu,Imfura zabo zose uzihindure nka Zeba na Zalumuna,

14.text: Mana yanjye, ubahindure nk'umukungugu ujyanwa na serwakira,Nk'umurama utumurwa n'umuyaga.

15.text: Nk'uko umuriro utwika ishyamba,Nk'uko ibirimi by'umuriro bitwika imisozi,

16.text: Abe ari ko ubahigisha umuyaga wawe,Ubateze ubwoba umuyaga wawe w'ishuheri.

17.text: Wuzuze mu maso habo ipfunwe ry'igisuzuguriro,Kugira ngo bashake izina ryawe, Uwiteka.

18.text: Bakorwe n'isoni batinye iteka ryose,Bamware barimbuke,

19.text: Kugira ngo bamenye yuko uwitwa UWITEKA,Ko ari wowe wenyine Usumbabyose utegeka isi yose.
